system.longDesc: Regain the SP you spent on this stunt, plus 1 more, to spend on any other stunt that fits your action. You perform the stunt in a way that offends one other character. They now consider you a rival, threat, or enemy, shifting their attitude to Hostile if it was Standoffish or Neutral, or shifting it to its negative variation if it was more positive. You can’t use this stunt if all NPCs present are already Hostile toward you.
